# Test fonts

Small subsets of Noto Sans Arabic, Devanagari, Hebrew and Thai and of Noto Sans CJK (fewer glyphs, hinting removed), used to test drawing of shaped glyph runs and paragraph layout.
They are Font Software under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; `OFL.txt` carries the copyright lines and the license text. They are test
inputs only and are never packed into a NuGet package.
